name: My Ride Is Here: Hop on the Broom and Fly Off Beside the Car
blurb: The My Ride Is Here broom trend is a Halloween 2026 video joke: filmed from a car window, someone pulls up on a flying broom, smiles at the camera and flies away, as if the broom were their ride.
